cwe_descriptions: CWE-184: Incomplete List of Disallowed Inputs — The product implements a protection mechanism that relies on a list of inputs (or properties of inputs) that are not allowed by policy or otherwise require other action to neutralize before additional processing takes place, but the list is incomplete.
CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data — The product deserializes untrusted data without sufficiently ensuring that the resulting data will be valid.
